synth.notes:
21x21 grid of 3x3 blocks, two wall axes (H band row, V strip col) parsed by argmax wall blocks; targets = any 11 in block, pieces = 4-conn comps of ring-5 blocks.
Every off-axis piece block mirrors across V, across H and across both as visible solid-4 blocks (clipped to board, not over pieces).
Stack piece > reflection > target (solid 11) > V wall > H wall; selected axis/piece shows 0 centres; centre = first solid else top fill.
A5 cycles H -> V -> pieces by min (row,col); A1/A2 move H or piece vertically, A3/A4 move V or piece horizontally; pieces blocked by edge/other pieces; HUD col 63 ticks 11->12 per effective action (stateless).
Unconfirmed: behaviour when a piece sits on an axis row/col or axes are blocked by pieces (never observed).
